message: Hey John, we're running a small builder's dinner in SF with folks doing interesting work in developer tools and ML infra—Louan from UCSF and Artem from Osmosis AI are already locked in, along with a few other operators pushing on agentic AI and cloud-native systems. Given your work on zero-downtime deployment practices at Cloudfitters and your conviction that agentic AI is the next frontier, felt like you'd be a good fit for the room. Want in?
